answer: Here is one concrete wall: Proof of unique airline check-in pattern. It works because check-ins on the same routes for three years, and the quartz it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Fakes fail here because check-ins on the same routes for three years is tied to something outside the network; the ripple of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the anchor is that the farm's unit economics never work.
